open_points.text: register_work_payment: [BEHAVIOR] MUST validate the amount through validate_eur_amount with the portal currency, the imported MONEY_CURRENCY constant, and strictly_positive true before opening any transaction, so a FinancialValidationError changes nothing; payment_id is the replay identity: equal payment_id/content returns existing, conflict changes nothing, and a new payment plus the payment.register member of = models.AuditAction, named PAYMENT_REGISTER in the enumeration, audit commits atomically without creating an invoice/accounting posting.
